# Set up directories and variables
```{r}
# setwd('scripts/')
proj_prefix <- "AVITI_MiSeq_comparison"
proj_name <- "AVITI VS MiSeq Comparison"

data_directory <- paste0('../data/filtered_seq_data/')

getwd()
barchart_directory <- paste0("../figures/bar_charts/")

marker = "18S"
```



# Load libraries
```{r}

#load libraries
library(readr) #read csv files

library(dplyr) # for data manipulation
library(ggplot2) # for plotting data
library(ggthemes) # for plotting data
library(magrittr) # for piping commands

# library("viridis") # for color fill 


library(tidyverse) # for data manipulation
```

# Load in Data
```{r}

#ASV table
otu.c <- read_csv(paste0(data_directory, proj_prefix, "_", marker, "_asv_filtered.csv"))
otu.c

#taxa table
tax.c <- read_csv(paste0(data_directory, proj_prefix, "_", marker, "_taxa_filtered.csv"))
tax.c

#metadata table
samp.c <- read_csv(paste0(data_directory, proj_prefix, "_", marker, "_meta_filtered.csv")) %>%
  mutate(sample_source = fct_relevel(sample_source,  "CN23 MARS" , "MBTS 17024", "MBTS 20524", "MBTS 22624", "MBTS 25424", "CN24F 150m exp"))
samp.c



#OTU table long format with percent total reads
potu.c <- otu.c %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer( -ASV, names_to ='sample_name',values_to = 'reads' ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  mutate(per_tot = reads / sum(reads) *100) %>% #proportions(reads)*100
  arrange(-reads)
head(potu.c)


```



## set lowest taxonomic annotation level for ASVs
```{r}

  species_label <- tax.c %>%
  # assign  algae
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Raphidophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Phaeophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Pelagophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Dictyochophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Chrysophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Synurophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Bolidophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Eustigmatophyceae" ~ "Ochrophyta", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  # assign oomycotes
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Oomycota" ~ "Oomycota", T ~ Phylum))  %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Oomycetes" ~ "Oomycota", T ~ Phylum))%>%
  # assign microeuk
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Bigyra" ~ "Bigyra", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Choanoflagellata" ~ "Choanoflagellata", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Cryptophyceae" ~ "Cryptista", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Order == "Telonemida" ~ "Cryptista", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Haptophyta" ~ "Haptista", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Centroplasthelida" ~ "Haptista", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Ichthyosporea" ~ "Choanozoa", T ~ Phylum))  %>% 
  
  mutate(Class = case_when(Phylum == "Imbricatea" ~ "Imbricatea", T ~ Class)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Imbricatea" ~ "Cercozoa", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Polycystinea" ~ "Retaria", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Acantharea" ~ "Retaria", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Breviatea" ~ "Sulcozoa", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Aphelidea" ~ "Aphelida", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Class == "Filasterea" ~ "Choanozoa", T ~ Phylum)) %>%
  
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(Phylum %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit") ~ "unknown", T ~ Phylum)) %>% 
  mutate(Class = case_when(Class %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit") ~ "unknown", T ~ Class)) %>% 
  mutate(Order = case_when(Order %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit") ~ "unknown", T ~ Order)) %>% 
  mutate(Family = case_when(Family %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit") ~ "unknown", T ~ Family)) %>% 
  mutate(Genus = case_when(Genus %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit", "g_") ~ "unknown", T ~ Genus)) %>% 
  mutate(Species = case_when(Species %in% c("unknown", "unassigned", "no_hit", "s_") ~ "unknown", T ~ Species))

  species_label


```


```{r}

inner_join(samp.c, potu.c, by = c("sample_name")) %>% 
  left_join(tax.c) %>%
  # group_by(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>%
  
  filter(Phylum %in% c("unknown", "no_hit", "unassigned")) %>% 
  arrange(-per_tot)

```



# Compile data - 
```{r}

# environmental data
env_data <- inner_join(samp.c, potu.c, by = c("sample_name")) %>% 
  left_join(species_label)

env_data 


```
